raw.name: Yellow Fang

dictionary.lore: This yellow fossil of a great beast's fang can be mined from the Bricio Volcano in the north-eastern part Elgaia. At its current stage, a refining process has not yet been discovered, but many blacksmiths are working towards finding a usable method.
